text: The June 2025 due-diligence claim—that no tree-cover loss was detected on this property—is no longer valid. The current evidence (as of November 2026) shows a **pending but likely tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 ha (3.9% of the asset) in 2025**, detected by the Hansen GFC dataset and supported by high agreement (98%) with the JRC 2020 forest reference. However, this loss is not yet fully corroborated (it requires confirmation in a later year, which has not been observed yet). The 2025 loss was not detected in the earlier 2024 dataset (valid through 2024), so the June 2025 report was correct for its timeframe. **The property now has evidence of potential loss post-2024, though the cause and permanence remain unclear.**
